title: Tipping With the Arm Out: The Centre of Mass of Base, Arm and Load, and How Hard the Base May Brake or Turn

questions.question: What moves when the arm moves?
options: The centre of mass of the whole, and so the tipping limits
questions.explanation: Every kilogram at the end of the arm moves it.

questions.question: The braking limit with the arm tucked was:
With 5 kg in the hand the braking limit was:
options: 5.19 m/s2, below what the wheels would grip

questions.question: What does a centred mass give?
options: The formula of 19-09: g times half the track over the height

questions.question: Why is a limit chosen for the tucked arm unsafe?
options: The loaded or extended arm has a lower limit

questions.question: Which turn is the dangerous one?
options: A turn with the arm tucked
Towards the side the arm is reaching to
